text:
tara: Quick heads-up — Sentinelflow is pausing renewal until we complete their vendor-risk form and provide DPA signature. They called out embeddings retention and audit log samples as blockers.

mike: Jordan (CRO) said they need this resolved before Friday or they'll pause renewal.

pranav: I can draft a retention attestation + a sanitized log snippet. Will need legal sign-off before sharing logs. Also can run a 45–60min security walkthrough for their team.

sophia: I can kick off a DPA amendment via e-sign. Need the exact retention language you want us to promise (sample below) or a flag to keep as 'company standard'.

tara: Proposed quick plan:
1) @pranav -> attestation + sanitized log sample (ETA: EOD today)
2) @sophia -> prepare DPA amendment & DocuSign flow (ETA: 24h)
3) schedule security walkthrough with customer Wed 10am PT
4) @mike -> confirm attendees and forward any additional questionnaire items
I'll update the renewal-risk board and mark this as High.

onboarding-bot: Created task <RISK-4852> and checklist:
```
- Attestation PDF
- Sanitized log sample (no PII)
- DPA amendment prepared
- Security walkthrough scheduled
- Renewal risk labeled 'High'
```

mike: Jordan confirmed Wed 10–11am PT. Attendees: Jordan, Priya (security), Alex (ops).

pranav: Noted. I'll include KMS/key-rotation notes and a short summary of our prefix/KV caching retention policy. Will attach sanitized logs as a password-protected bundle. ETA EOD.

sophia: Starting DocuSign flow now. Will share preview in #legal-review channel and cc @tara.

tara: Thanks — I'll send the meeting invite and a short pre-walkthrough questionnaire to Jordan: https://forms.gle/example-prewalk

mike: If legal needs anything specific from Jordan (e.g., PO or legal contact), ping me and I'll get it immediately.

tara: Great job team. If we hit any stalls, we'll escalate to AM lead. :thumbsup:
